stem: Reading chunks of Shapiro’s verse in one sitting, it must be said, exposes the ____ nature of his writing: scads of poems are too glancing to strike a nerve, scarcely worth a second reading.

According to Dr. Edith Widder, measuring the level of pollutants in sediment provides a more accurate and robust indication of an estuary's health than does measuring the level of chemicals in the water, since pollution in water is (i)____, but pollution in sediment is (ii)____.

As the pace of the trial (i)____, the wait at the beginning of the day became less interminable, and the attorneys’ requests to suspend proceeding for private conferences with the judge, almost invariably granted early on, were routinely (ii)____.

During the Harlem Renaissance, Alain Locke (i)____ the first flourishing of a self-consciously racial art movement in America and was widely credited with providing the philosophical basis for its emergence. His importance as a critic of African America art and as an art theorist is (ii)____ if controversial, yet he has received (iii)____ attention for his unique insight into the broad forces that shaped American modernism and cultural nationalism in the visual arts.
To call Kermode the finest English critic of his generation would be a ____ compliment, since not many of its population are professionally engaged in literary criticism.
optsZh: 间接的，含沙射影的，虚情假意的
